## `contacts_list`

Class: read

List all contacts (paginated)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `pageSize` | number | optional | Number of contacts per page (default: 50) |
| `pageToken` | string | optional | Page token for pagination |
| `sortOrder` | enum | optional | Sort order (default: FIRST_NAME_ASCENDING) |
| `requireEmail` | boolean | optional | Only return contacts with at least one email address. Filtering happens after the page is fetched, so the returned page can hold fewer than pageSize contacts; nextPageToken still continues the underlying, unfiltered listing |
| `requireName` | boolean | optional | Only return contacts with a name. Filtering happens after the page is fetched, so the returned page can hold fewer than pageSize contacts; nextPageToken still continues the underlying, unfiltered listing |

## `contacts_resolve`

Class: read

Resolve a free-text name/alias to ONE canonical email address (ranked + tie-broken), so you need not hand-expand transliteration OR-queries. Returns a single confident match, an explicit ambiguous candidate list, or null when nothing matches. When no contact matches, it falls back to names seen in recent mail headers (source "gmail"). For picking a recipient before gmail_send.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `name` | string | required | Free-text name or alias to resolve (e.g. "Zoe") |
| `maxCandidates` | number | optional | Max candidates to return when ambiguous (1-10, default: 5) |
| `includeOtherContacts` | boolean | optional | Also search auto-saved "other contacts" (people you have emailed but not saved). Default true. |
| `includeMailHeaders` | boolean | optional | When no contact matches, look for the name in the From/To/Cc headers of recent mail (needs Gmail access; skipped silently without it). Default true. |
